references.text: Mentions the five Philistine lords who ruled over the Philistines
Refers to Lebo-Hamah as a boundary of Israel's land
Describes Lebo-Hamah as the northern border of the promised land
Mentions the area from the Desert of Sin to Rehob near Lebo-Hamah
Refers to Mount Hermon and the Sidonian name for it
Mentions the Hivites who lived at the foot of Hermon
Lists the peoples in the land, including the Hivites
Mentions the Hivites among the peoples who gathered against Israel
Mentions the five Philistine lords and their cities
Describes Solomon's kingdom from Lebo-Hamah to the Brook of Egypt
